lines.text: My sister left a blue jar beside the gate.
She did not break it; I did.
I never said you were the one who left.
Not because I stopped loving you, but because I could not make you stay.
She gave me the unmailed letter.
I didn't burn it. I hid it in the old jacket.
You didn't forget me. I didn't dare to stop you.
If it keeps raining, I'll wait for you; if it stops, I won't leave.
It wasn't you who was looking at the moon, it was me.
The light didn't go out, only I closed my eyes.
I didn't say I wouldn't go home. I said I couldn't go home tonight.
My friend didn't turn the lights off. The wind's off.
It's not that he's sad he's gone, but that he can't say goodbye.
Come back, come back, I didn't wait yesterday, it's today.
